انتحرتا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَرَتَا (intaḥaratā) /in.ta.ħa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اُنْتُحِرَتَا (untuḥiratā) /un.tu.ħi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
